title: Participation
description: An organisation's role in an event, a publication, a split or a programme.

organization.description: The organisation's wallet, or its id under localIds.

context.description: What kind of thing it participates in.

contextId.description: The id of that thing, in the system that owns it.

role.description: Its role there, in that context's own words. Free text: the vocabulary belongs to the context.
